caption:
Better gear won't fix it. Reps will. 🏓

Same goal, two plans. One practices 10 minutes a day. One buys better gear. Day 30, he misses again. Next day, he plays again. A year later: a 120-hit rally vs $960 of paddles on the wall.

Listen to the rally get longer.

Send this to someone who buys gear first.

#pingpong #tabletennis #practice #discipline #habits
